Local Estate Jewelry Buyers

If you’re looking to sell estate jewelry, get an appraisal, or find a buyer, CaratBase connects you with verified local buyers in your metro area. Start with three free leads and pay only when you accept a qualified offer.

How It Works

  1. Sign Up – No account needed to begin.
  2. Receive Leads – Get verified local buyers who are actively looking to purchase estate jewelry.
  3. Accept an Offer – Pay $40 for each accepted lead.
  4. Optional Valuation Widget – Add a $29/month valuation tool to your website to capture leads directly.

CaratBase is currently available in Atlanta and is expanding to other major U.S. metros.

Why Choose CaratBase

  • Verified Local Buyers – Only leads from buyers who have been vetted and are ready to transact.
  • Cost‑Effective – First three leads are free; thereafter, you pay only for leads you accept.
  • No Upfront Commitment – Pay per accepted lead, no long‑term contracts.
  • Easy Integration – The optional valuation widget can be added to your website with minimal effort.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Are the leads truly local? A: Yes, CaratBase targets buyers within your specific metro area to ensure quick, convenient transactions.

Q: What happens after I accept a lead? A: Once you accept a lead, you’ll receive the buyer’s contact details and can proceed with the sale or appraisal directly.

Q: Is there a minimum number of leads I must purchase? A: No. You can buy as many accepted leads as you need, paying only for those you choose to accept.

Next Step

Ready to connect with local estate jewelry buyers? Visit CaratBase and start your first free lead today.
